1.explanation: The TableBatchAction component wraps the underlying Button and always provides an iconDescription default of “Add” and marks iconDescription as required. This default value is inappropriate for most batch actions and leads to incorrect announcements by screen readers. To fix the bug, the defaultProps.iconDescription should be changed to an empty string, and iconDescription should only be required when the consumer does not supply children (the visible label). Adjusting the propTypes and defaultProps in TableBatchAction.js corrects the default behavior and ensures proper accessibility without modifying the API surface for consumers.
1.bug_scenario: In the TableBatchAction examples, when no iconDescription prop is provided the default value of “Add” is used, causing screen readers (JAWS) to announce “Edit Add Button” or “Reset Add Button” even though the visible label is “Edit” or “Reset.” Conversely, when an iconDescription matching the visible label is provided, JAWS announces the label twice (e.g. “Edit Edit Button”). The iconDescription should default to an empty string and only be required when there is no visible button label.

2.explanation: The TableBatchAction component in TableBatchAction.js is the source of the incorrect default for iconDescription. Its defaultProps sets iconDescription to “Add”, which is wrong for cases where a visible child label exists. Changing defaultProps.iconDescription to '' (and making the prop not strictly required when children are present) will fix the redundant or missing accessible text. No other components or functions impact this behavior.
2.bug_scenario: When no explicit iconDescription prop is provided on a TableBatchAction, the component falls back to its defaultProps.iconDescription of “Add”. In VoiceOver/JAWS this causes buttons with visible text labels (e.g. “Edit” or “Reset”) to be announced redundantly as “Edit Add Button” or “Reset Add Button”. Conversely, when a developer does supply an iconDescription, it reads twice (“Edit Edit Button”). The correct behavior is that iconDescription should default to an empty string and only be required when there is no visible label.
